summary: Public interest litigation challenging Telangana medical admission rules; reservation doctrine: meritorious reserved candidates ('MRC') treated as general category; constitutional bench precedents (Indra Sawhney, R.K. Sabharwal) reiterate unavailability of double benefit—reserved candidates admitted on merit don't count against reserved quota; issue deemed inappropriate for PIL due to case-specific complexities in postgraduate specialty admissions; dismissal with guidance for High Courts to adjudicate individual cases.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 16(4) of the Constitution of India
Indra Sawhney v. Union of India
R.K. Sabharwal v. State of Punjab
Union of India v. Virpal Singh Chauhan
S.P. Gupta v. Union of India
final_judgment: Writ petition disposed of; High Courts to consider individual cases on merits.
